description: This file defines a utility class `BaseMessageFilter` in the package `org.eclipse.hono.util`. It provides static methods to verify the existence and correctness of certain properties in AMQP messages, used for message validation within the Eclipse Hono messaging framework.
external_methods: ResourceIdentifier.from(String endpoint, String tenantId, String deviceId)

classes.name: BaseMessageFilter
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to validate AMQP message properties, ensuring presence and correctness of device IDs and correlation IDs used within the messaging protocol.

methods.name: verifyStandardProperties
methods.description: Checks if the message contains valid device ID and annotates the message with resource info if valid.

methods.name: hasValidDeviceId
methods.description: Validates the presence and correctness of the device ID in the message against the resource identifier.

methods.name: hasCorrelationId
methods.description: Determines whether the message has either a message ID or a correlation ID for message correlation purposes.
